criteria: Four individually reviewed complete public Platform token/field routes; eleven complete context members and seven public flag reads. Source preparation only.

complete_context_members.name: MatCommonModule.constructor
_checkThemeIsPresent

reviews.decision: The complete dev-mode constructor optionally resolves the public Platform service and passes its public isBrowser flag through boolean conversion to the owned theme-check predicate. It reads no browser-family flags or private platform ID and never calls the Platform constructor. Genuine tagged/minimum provider and null-provider cases support the token/field boundary; module creation, high-contrast initialization and rendered theme detection retain separate obligations.
reviews.reviewer: Codex primary implementer; individual complete public Platform caller review
reviews.scope_limit: Named public token/field dependency only; no broad module,date,viewport,dialog focus,component,native,packed,consumer or floor clearance.

complete_context_members.name: LegacyNativeDateAdapter.constructor

reviews.decision: The retained _platform parameter has the current public Platform type and no date-logic reads. The untouched16.2.14 NativeDateAdapter constructor also retains this ignored parameter. Its type can still be used as an Angular DI token; this review does not pretend it is erased from factory metadata. Public class identity and normal provider resolution are supported without invoking the21.x compatibility constructor. Adapter factories, date behavior and historical deprecated adapter APIs remain separately owned.

complete_context_members.name: ViewportState
_LegacyViewport.constructor
_LegacyViewport.ngOnDestroy
_LegacyViewport.getViewportSize
_LegacyViewport.getViewportScrollPosition

reviews.decision: The complete viewport state interface, constructor, destruction, size and scroll methods consume only public Platform.isBrowser. The flag controls listener registration/removal and nonbrowser values; no Platform constructor or private field is used. Size access resolves its window before testing the flag,matching the untouched16.2.14 helper. The preserved no-window observation therefore remains visible and grants no Angular SSR guarantee. Public flag identity/behavior supports this dependency; viewport geometry,caching,event lifetimes and native roots keep their separate gates.

complete_context_members.name: ambientService
_MatDialogContainerBase._isBrowser

reviews.decision: The complete ambient-service function resolves the public Platform token only in an existing injection context. The owned field is consumed by _isBrowser through a nullish fallback,so an explicit false service flag takes precedence over DOM availability. Normal public service identity and boolean/null behavior are supported at both minima without a compatibility constructor call. Manual construction, fallback policy, focus trapping/restoration and component/native behavior retain their separate evidence requirements.
